2607.11436.title: The Ebb and Flow of Multimodal Focus: Scheduling Visual Relay Windows for Grounded VLM Reasoning
2607.11436.paper_summary: Vision-language models increasingly succeed on multimodal reasoning benchmarks, yet their visual evidence often becomes unstable once it enters the language stack, weakening evidence-grounded reasoning. To understand this fragility, we examine the internal dynamics of VLMs through a mechanistic lens and uncover a stable three-stage redistribution of multimodal attention focus across depth: an early question-conditioned organization, a critical middle visual-dominant relay, and a late return to answer formation. We operationalize the middle phase as the Visual Relay Window (VRW), and show that its geometry varies with task demand, is causally tied to grounded generation, and distinguishes unsupported answers from stronger reasoning trajectories. Guided by this internal rhythm, we propose TRACE, a task-adaptive inference-time control framework with lightweight trained modules. It reshapes relay allocation during prefill and preserves assembled visual support after handoff during decoding. Across four open-weight VLM backbones and seven benchmarks, TRACE delivers large gains on grounding-sensitive settings, improving them by 4.33 points on average and by up to 6.6 points, while also improving reasoning-heavy tasks. These results show that explicitly controlling multimodal focus across depth offers a unified and effective mechanism for strengthening evidence-grounded multimodal reasoning.
2607.11436.paper_summary_zh: 視覺-語言模型在多模態推理基準上越來越成功，然而它們的視覺證據一旦進入語言堆疊後，往往變得不穩定，削弱了基於證據的推理。為了理解這種脆弱性，我們通過機械視角檢視VLM的內部動態，並揭示了多模態注意力焦點在深度上的穩定三階段重新分配：早期的問題條件組織、關鍵的中間視覺主導中繼，以及晚期的答案形成回歸。我們將中間階段操作化為視覺中繼窗口（Visual Relay Window, VRW），並顯示其幾何形狀隨任務需求而變化，與基於證據的生成有因果關聯，並區分不支持的答案與更強的推理軌跡。在這種內部節奏的指導下，我們提出了TRACE，一種具有輕量訓練模塊的任務自適應推理時間控制框架。它在預填充期間重塑中繼分配，並在解碼期間保持組裝的視覺支持。通過四個開放權重的VLM骨幹和七個基準，TRACE在基於證據的敏感設置上提供了顯著的增益，平均提高4.33分，最高可達6.6分，同時也改善了重推理任務。這些結果顯示，明確控制多模態焦點在深度上的分配提供了一種統一且有效的機制，以加強基於證據的多模態推理。
